raw_segments.text: Swounds, show me what thou'lt do, walt weep.
Walt fight, walt fast, walt tear thyself.
Walt drink up isle, eat a crocodile I'll dot.
Dost thou come here to whine, to outface me with leaping in her grave?
Be buried quick with her, and so will I, and if thou prayed of mountains, let them throw
millions of acres on us, till our ground, singeing his pate against the burning zone,
Nay in thou'lt mouth I'll rant as well as thou.
